digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler outbound differ — comment path
propositions: When a local parent is non-epic but the Jira project permits only Epic parents, the parent field is suppressed outbound, leaving the child as an under-defined leaf with no context hint.
An echo-safe breadcrumb comment must be appended to the child issue naming the nearest ancestor with a bound Jira key, decorated with RECONCILER_MARKER to prevent inbound re-ingestion.

The breadcrumb is emitted from the outbound comment differ (_diff_comments) as a single ADD mutation, deduped via a stable identity tag (<!-- rebar:parent-breadcrumb -->) to ensure append-once behavior even if the nearest represented ancestor changes across passes.
If intervening ancestors lack bound Jira keys, the breadcrumb notes their absence and names only the nearest bound ancestor.
No breadcrumb is emitted if no ancestor in the walk chain has a bound Jira key, or if the child's direct parent is absent from the ticket type map.
The drift-condition parity ensures that a present non-epic parent is both suppressed outbound and breadcrumbed, while a present epic parent or absent parent triggers neither.
